steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const pw=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const doors=pw.puddlewickLayout().doors;const rooms=[['hollybank','hollybank'],['puddlewick_inn','puddlewick_inn'],['puddlewick_bakery','int_bakery'],['puddlewick_shop','int_shop'],['puddlewick_chapel','int_chapel'],['puddlewick_mill','int_mill'],['hollybank_barn','int_barn'],['puddlewick_twins','int_twins'],['puddlewick_hob','int_hob'],['puddlewick_cottage','int_cottage']];const out=[];for(const [plot,room] of rooms){const d=doors[plot];const step=pw.puddlewickDoorstep(plot);__DQ.teleport(room);await sleep(800);__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',step.x,step.z);await sleep(400);for(let i=0;i<12;i++)await sleep(150);const after=__DQ.state().map.id;const p=__DQ.state().player;out.push({plot,room,step,after,ok:after==='puddlewick',x:p&&+p.x.toFixed(2),z:p&&+p.z.toFixed(2)}); }window.__EXIT=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()
